title: Use AUTOVERSION.py as single source of truth for KosCMS version
instructions: Update webcms/__init__.py to import VERSION from AUTOVERSION.py, update webcms/admin-ui/package.json to match, update README.md header, update webcms/admin/admin_api.py docstring, and update hardcoded version strings in webcms/app_factory.py homepage/status endpoints.

1783888563.8601105.instruction: Inspect webcms/admin/api.py and webcms/admin-ui/src/admin/pages/*.jsx to map which /api/v1/admin/* endpoints are called and what JSON shapes each management screen expects.

1783888566.986434.instruction: Add route handlers in webcms/admin/api.py (or a new module) for all required admin endpoints: dashboard, content, media, templates, themes, plugins, users, roles, settings, cache, backups, workflows, tenants, search, notifications. Return valid JSON so screens render without 404 errors.

1783888570.404498.instruction: Update README.md with a section explaining how to create the first admin user and set their password (e.g., via CLI, database seed, or config). Make it clear for new deployments.

1783888573.6126766.instruction: Update webcms/__init__.py and webcms/admin-ui/package.json to version 1.3.4. Run syntax checks and verify the new admin endpoints return JSON without 404 errors.

1783889843.856744.instruction: Replace the hardcoded __version__ assignment in webcms/__init__.py with an import from AUTOVERSION.py: `from AUTOVERSION import VERSION as __version__`. Ensure the file still exports Application, Request, Response.

1783889846.479976.instruction: Update webcms/admin-ui/package.json version field to "1.3.6" and update the README.md header version string from "1.3.0" to "1.3.6".

1783889849.3019876.instruction: Replace hardcoded "1.1.0" in /api/v1/status and "KosCMS v1.3.3" in the homepage HTML with the version imported from webcms.__version__ (which now comes from AUTOVERSION.py).

1783889851.7733688.instruction: Update the docstring in webcms/admin/admin_api.py from "Admin API v1.3.4" to "Admin API v1.3.6". Run syntax checks on all modified files.
